limitations: Selection uses observed pass differences; evidence generation never reads reference answers or hidden tests. This is discovery, not blinded validation.
Public certificates are authored manually after seeing outcomes; no automatic verifier or policy performance is established.
No message-removal or replacement intervention was run; compatibility with a bad suggestion does not prove its causal effect.
Only observed Full/first-round discordances are covered; this is not an all-task false-positive or recall evaluation.
Child processes have timeouts but no filesystem/network security sandbox; only previously archived local outputs are executed.
